title: The French Far Right Embraces Austerity
gist: Laurent Warlouzet notes that Marine Le Pen has unveiled an RN economic program centered on rapid fiscal consolidation, a sharp break with the party's past. Whether this 'populist austerity' works will shape her future and possibly that of Europe's nationalist right.

insights.claim: Marine Le Pen, leader of France's far-right National Rally, has unveiled an economic program centered on rapid fiscal consolidation, i.e., austerity.
insights.speaker: LAURENT WARLOUZET
insights.so_what: A fiscally hawkish RN platform lowers the perceived risk of a debt-fueled spending spree under a far-right government, relevant to OAT spreads.
